# Vedaang Sharma — Portfolio

> Full Stack & AI Systems Developer building intelligent web applications, AI/ML systems, distributed backends, and modern software architectures.

## Overview
Vedaang Sharma is a Full Stack and AI Systems Developer based in Jaipur, India. He specializes in designing and building high-performance web applications, computer vision models, generative AI integrations, and cloud architectures.

## Featured Technical Expertise
- **Frontend & Web Platforms**: Next.js (App Router), React 19, JavaScript (ESNext), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Responsive & Accessible UI Design, Core Web Vitals optimization.
- **Backend & Systems**: Node.js, Express, Next.js API routes, Python, REST APIs, GraphQL, WebSockets, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Upstash Redis, authentication & authorization.
- **AI & Machine Learning**: Computer Vision, Deep Learning, PyTorch, LangChain, LLM prompt engineering and agent workflows, model inference optimization.
- **DevOps & Tooling**: Git, GitHub, Vercel, Docker, CI/CD, PostHog analytics, performance monitoring.
